title: QueryMessage
description: Control-topic record format for the broker-side selector filter function. Each record is published to the control topic keyed by a stable query-id. The function maintains a Pulsar TableView over the control topic; publishes with a non-null body register or hot-reload the compiled selector for that query-id; publishes with a null/empty body (TableView tombstone) retract the query and stop fan-out. The JSON contract below describes the non-tombstone body; tombstones have no body and are not schema-validated.

name.description: Human-readable label used in function logs. Optional; absent or null is fine.

selector.description: JMS-selector expression — a SQL92 WHERE-clause subset evaluated against record bindings: __key__ (decoded UTF-8 message key), __topic__ (fully-qualified source topic with -partition-N stripped), and any Pulsar user property by name. Parsed by Apache ActiveMQ SelectorParser via com.datastax.oss:pulsar-jms-filters-common; SDKs validate selector syntax client-side before publishing. Must be non-empty.

outputTopic.description: Fully-qualified Pulsar topic the function writes matching messages to. The function honors forwardSourceMessageProperty and retainKeyOrdering, so payload bytes, key, and user properties are forwarded verbatim. Must be a persistent or non-persistent Pulsar topic FQN.
